2116549628527309309.en_summary: $QQQ Chart Update: Wow what an eventful week las week for the Q's eh?! The 200dma is coming up, came close to testing it yesterday. I imagine given how close we are to it, it becomes a self-fulfilling prophecy aka magnet? Why not. If so, bulls gotta bounce off it, otherwise the green and blue lines will be next area of major support which is not too far either, just another -4% or so drawdown. Which we have seen can be achieved in one day like yesterday. RSI not showing any oversold readings which gets me slightly concerned that maybe we need one? I don't think we will see a 2018 Nov/Dec type crash. I'm looking for a very healthy rebound in the next coming week or two for the nice eoy finish. Now 2027 will be a different story... Stay tuned for that.
2116549628527309309.zh_summary: $QQQ圖表更新：哇，上週對Q's來說真是多事的一周啊？！200日均線即將來臨，昨天接近測試它。我想像鑒於我們離它這麼近，它會成為自我實現的預言，又稱磁鐵？為什麼不。如果是這樣，多頭必須從它反彈，否則綠線和藍線將是下一個主要支撑區域，也不太遠，只是再約-4%的回撤。我們已經看到這可以在一天內實現，如昨天。RSI沒有顯示任何超賣讀數，這讓我略微擔心也許我們需要一個？我不認為我們會看到2018年11/12月類型的崩潰。我期待在接下來的一兩週內非常健康的反彈，以獲得不錯的年底收官。現在2027年將是不同的故事……敬請關注。

ticker_notes.QQQ: 接近200日均線，期待一兩週內健康反彈
